claim: Budapest: Google Maps flags Foot Locker's Váci utca 14 store (pedestrian-street flagship, 779 reviews) and its Mammut store as permanently closed, and neither appears on FL's live Hungarian store locator. Váci utca 14 still had ordinary reviews on 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-21 (staff named), so it closed, or was flagged, within roughly the last two weeks. The last Mammut review is dated 2026-05-20. Hungary is down to 4 locator stores: ETELE Plaza, Arena Mall, Árkád and Westend.
data_point: Váci u 14 (placeId ChIJ69c1JkHcQUcR9hM3x_JD7SI): permanentlyClosed=true, 779 reviews, last review 2026-09-21. Mammut Lövőház u. 2-6 (ChIJ65YM_dnfQUcRC8Jlh_y-qTg): permanentlyClosed=true, 41 reviews, last review 2026-05-20. stores.footlocker.hu sitemap on 2026-10-07 lists 4 store pages (13802 Árkád, 13803 ETELE, 13804 Westend, 13807 Arena). FL careers job 64718 (sales associate, posted 2025-10-23) is located at 'Vaci U 14, 1052 Budapest', which confirms it was an FL-operated store after the deal.
source_name: Google Maps via Apify (dataset oMDg3zDMsV4VJN5RM) plus stores.footlocker.hu/sitemap.xml plus careers.footlocker.com job 64718
original_quote: Orsi was especially wonderful. She confirmed that the trainers were in stock (Váci u 14 review, 2026-09-21)
verifier_note: I re-pulled Apify dataset oMDg3zDMsV4VJN5RM: 6 items, with Váci u 14 and Mammut both permanentlyClosed=true. I re-fetched the live HU sitemap: 4 store pages, neither store listed. Careers job 64718 places a post-deal role at Vaci U 14 (datePosted 2025-10-23). I did not verify whether the Váci page was ever on the locator (no Wayback snapshot of the HU sitemap), so absence from the locator alone does not date the exit. Trading reviews to 2026-09-21 make the Google flag very fresh, and I found no press or on-the-ground confirmation (WebSearch budget exhausted), so this stays PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED. If real, it is a capital-city flagship exit after the 8/1/26 count of 559. I did not check the scraper's claim that Váci utca 14 is the registered seat of Foot Locker Hungary Kft. (01-09-718211). Not in any baseline or confirmed file.

claim: FL's own European store locator shows 'closed' on all seven days for three more stores not yet reported: Ulm Blautal-Center (Blaubeurer Str. 95, store 03187), Częstochowa Galeria Jurajska (store 13015) and the Kids Foot Locker in Aulnay-sous-Bois O'Parinor (store 65132). The same signal appears on Avignon Rue des Marchands, which the press confirms closed on 2026-09-15. These look like closures in progress or just completed, after the 8/1/26 count.

Ulm 03187 page shows 'Montag Geschlossen' through 'Sonntag Geschlossen'. The Częstochowa Google listing (al. Wojska Polskiego 207) is still open, last review 2026-08-14. The main Parinor FL store (05132) is open on Google, last review 2026-09-11. The other Ulm store (Bahnhofstraße 3) is open.
original_quote: Su closed Mo closed Tu closed We closed Th closed Fr closed Sa closed
verifier_note: Live check on 2026-10-07. Ulm page via WebFetch: every day 'Geschlossen'. Częstochowa (https://stores.footlocker.pl/en/pl-pd/czestochowa/foot-locker-poland-13015-5856_31_13015.html) and Aulnay (https://stores.footlocker.fr/en/fr-34/aulnay-sous-bois/cc-oparinor-u-53a2-53a3-624_31_65132.html): HTTP 200, the JSON-LD openingHours string is all 'closed', and the Aulnay page carries 'Kids Foot Locker'. The data point is CONFIRMED. That the stores have closed is still an inference, so I downgraded A to B. For: Avignon shows the identical pattern and closed on 2026-09-15 (already confirmed by press in B_w1/D_w1_chatter). Against: Lyon Confluence shows the same pattern with 'Fermée temporairement', which may mean a refit. Mall directories for Blautal-Center and Galeria Jurajska could not be loaded (connection refused / 404). Avignon and Lyon are excluded here as duplicates; Ulm, Częstochowa and Aulnay Kids are novel.

claim: Against / caveat: some Google 'permanently closed' FL listings are relistings or relocations, not exits, so raw Google closed counts overstate attrition. Arese Il Centro: the old pin is flagged closed but reviews continue to 2026-09-20, and a new open pin (Via Luraghi 11) is in the locator. Bolzano: a 2026-04-11 review says the store 'moved to the Walther Park centre', and a new pin at Via Perathoner 8 is open. Lille Euralille: one pin closed (last review 2026-02-07) while another Euralille pin is open and in the locator. Orio Center: the closed pin is probably the Kids unit, and other Orio units remain in the locator. FL was still hiring at Budapest Váci utca 14 in Oct-2025.
data_point: Arese old pin ChIJfS5c5L-UhkcRYiIoK47Of5c: permanentlyClosed=true, 809 reviews, last 2026-09-20; new pin Via Luraghi 11 open. Bolzano P.za Alto Adige 1 review 2026-04-11 'Ins Walterpark Zentrum umgezogen'; Perathoner 8 pin open. Careers job 64718 at Vaci U 14, posted 2025-10-23.

english_translation: Moved to the Walther Park centre
verifier_note: Checked against the local raw place JSON (IT.json) and full CSV: Arese and Bolzano reviews are as stated. Careers job 64718 was fetched and shows Vaci U 14, datePosted 2025-10-23. Orio 'Kids unit' and Euralille 'unit move' are the scraper's inference and are unverified. This mainly matters as a methodological caveat, since the D_w1_chatter verifier already flagged duplicates and relocations in the Google counts. Low incremental value, so tier C.
